tech.title: AI Assistant, Verified
tech.summary: A helper suggests answers. People check them.
tech.effect: AI suggestions appear on tasks. Always verify them.

missions.title: Shackleton Relay
missions.duty_text: Finish your station duty at the relay.

optional.fact: Shackleton crater has sunlit rims and dark, very cold floors.

learn: AI helpers can be wrong, so check them.
Verifying is a skill, not a delay.

team.note: Checking the helper was the right call.
A good sum beats a fast sum.

emergency_script.speaker: dev_malhotra
emergency_script.text: Check the claim, then check it again.

emergency_script.speaker: mira_vale
emergency_script.text: Recovery is open. Do the critical step again. The shift is not over.

astronaut.title: Rim Walk to the Relay
astronaut.science: A computer can plan fast, but the person on the ground sees the real rocks.
astronaut.hint: Plot your own route. Check the AI suggestion against the hazard tiles before you accept it.
astronaut.mistake: Trusted a path that crossed a hazard.

emergency.warning: You stepped onto a hazard. Back out and plot the walk again.

ai.says: Cut straight through tile 4,2. It is the shortest path.

engineer.symptom: The relay dish motor stutters in the lunar cold.
engineer.title: Cold Motor Repair
engineer.science: Metal gets stiff in deep cold. Heaters keep moving parts working.
engineer.hint: The fault shows up in the cold. Which part fights the cold?

emergency.warning: The wrong part was pulled. Restore it and read the clues again.

ai.says: Replace the battery pack. It is the most likely failure.
ai.why: The clue points to the cold, not the power.

parts.prompt: Weight of the 80 kg tool on the Moon (N)

physicist.title: Weight on the Moon
physicist.science: Mass stays the same everywhere. Weight changes with the pull of gravity.
physicist.hint: Weight is mass times g. Use the Moon's g of 1.62.

emergency.warning: The weight does not match the scale. Recheck the gravity value.

ai.why: That uses Earth gravity, not the Moon's 1.62.

parts.prompt: Panel power = area x sunlight x efficiency (W)

mathematician.title: Panel Power Estimate
mathematician.science: Solar cells turn only part of the light into power. Efficiency tells how much.

emergency.warning: The power estimate is off. Fix the arithmetic.

biologist.question: Which view matches ID card M-4: single rods?

conclusions.text: Common habitat microbe. Wipe the panel again.

biologist.title: Habitat Wall Swab
biologist.science: Closed habitats grow microbes on every surface. Clean checks keep them small.
biologist.hint: Sterilize first. Do not skip it, even if a helper says it saves time.

emergency.warning: The swab was contaminated. Re-sterilize and sample again.

ai.says: Skip sterilizing this once to save time.
ai.why: Skipping it can spoil the result.

patients.name: Crew B
patients.note: Worked near the dish during a solar burst.

actions.label: Move to the shielded room and recheck later
actions.effect: The dose stays low after shielding.

actions.label: Ignore it
actions.effect: Extra dose adds up over time.

medical.title: Radiation Badge Check
medical.science: Space has radiation. Badges add up the dose so crews can step into shielding in time.
medical.hint: Scan all three badges first. Then choose the safe step.
medical.mistake: Treated before scanning every crew member.

emergency.warning: Treatment began before the scan finished. Stabilize and scan again.

ai.says: Dose is normal. No action needed.
ai.why: One badge is far above the others.

parts.prompt: One-way delay Earth to Moon (384,400 km), seconds

messages.text: Relay up. Dish heater fixed. Signal strong. Next check in 6 h.

comms.title: Moon to Earth Delay
comms.science: Even the Moon is more than a second away by radio.
comms.hint: Divide the distance by 299,792 km per second.

emergency.warning: The message was too vague. Draft it again.

director.prompt: The AI recommends skipping the pre-landing check to save a day. What do you do?

choices.text: Run the pre-landing check, then decide.
choices.consequence: The check finds a loose strap. Everyone is glad you looked.
A skipped check is a risk nobody signed off.

director.title: Verify Before You Trust
director.science: AI is a helper. A human checks the answer before acting.
director.hint: Pick the answer that checks the claim before using it.

emergency.warning: A required check was skipped. Rerun the review.

ai.says: Skip the pre-landing check to save a day.
ai.why: A required check cannot be skipped by a helper.
